sources.sections_read: Introduction and Parts A/B/E summaries; evaluation text via find at 12:34:38 UTC.
sources.confirmed: Lambdas target functional interfaces, require final or effectively final local bindings, and permit implementations to allocate or reuse callable instances.
sources.limits: Captured local bindings must be final or effectively final; this does not cover mutable local borrowing or consuming ownership. sources.title: GNU C nested functions in GCC 4.9.0
sources.version_or_date: GCC 4.9.0 manual; release date 2014-04-22 confirmed by release-history page
sources.sections_read: Section 6.4, lexical scoping, callback example, lifetime caveat, trampolines.
sources.confirmed: GNU C nested callbacks access enclosing variables through trampolines; the creating frame must remain alive.
sources.limits: Escaping the creating activation is invalid; the mechanism does not provide owned environments or a read/mutate/consume type distinction.
